name: Level_1 - Task_1
description: Load the MACE-MP-0 foundation model as an ASE-compatible atomic calculator. Construct a bulk Silver (Ag) conventional face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell with a lattice parameter a = 4.09 Å, and expand it into a 4 × 4 × 4 supercell to yield exactly 256 Ag atoms. Run a molecular dynamics (MD) simulation using a Langevin thermostat at a target temperature of 300 K with a timestep of 1.0 fs and a friction coefficient of 0.01 fs⁻¹. Execute the simulation for 5000 steps and write the system state to an ASE trajectory file every 100 steps. Return the absolute path to the resulting trajectory file.
submission_format: string representing the absolute path to the output file (eg. '/path/to/trajectory.traj')
